HOME SCIENCE — MOCK EXAM #3
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: HOME SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

2. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Methods of Cooking? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Methods of Cooking.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Methods of Cooking.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Methods of Cooking.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Methods of Cooking.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Nutritive Value of Foods 1.5 Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene ? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Nutritive Value of Foods 1.5 Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene .
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Nutritive Value of Foods 1.5 Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene .
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Nutritive Value of Foods 1.5 Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene .
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Nutritive Value of Foods 1.5 Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene .

5. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 37 °C

6. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Producers
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Decomposers only

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Safety in the Home? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Safety in the Home.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Safety in the Home.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safety in the Home.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Safety in the Home.

8. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. newton (N)
   C. watt (W)
   D. pascal (Pa)

9. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Housing the Family? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Housing the Family.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Housing the Family.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Housing the Family.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Housing the Family.

11. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

   B. Iron rusting
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Milk souring

   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio.

   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio.

21. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

22. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Only carbon dioxide

----
